secretFields.name: apiKey
secretFields.label: Mailchimp API key
secretFields.description: Your Mailchimp API key in the form <key>-<dc>, for example abc123-us8. The datacenter is derived from the suffix. Create one at https://mailchimp.com/help/about-api-keys/.

secretFields.name: readOnly
secretFields.label: Read-only mode
secretFields.description: Optional. 'true' blocks every write tool for your account; reads still work. Leave empty to allow writes.

secretFields.name: dryRun
secretFields.label: Dry-run mode
secretFields.description: Optional. 'true' makes write tools return a preview of what they would do instead of calling Mailchimp. Leave empty to execute writes.
